## Orthologus networks {.tabset}
We use Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) to construct the co-expression network of the developmental time-series data for each species.  We construct the network for each species separately. 

### Soft threshold
This step estimates the power to achieve the scale free topology of the data. Choosing a soft threshold power for the developmental time-series data is not straight forward due to the dynamic nature of the gene expression. Therefore, I chose a power that balances the scale free nature of the data and it's mean connectivity to ensure that I don't get too sparse networks. I pick the power that has a scale-free R2 of at least 0.8. 

```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-001, eval=FALSE}
soft_threshold(clown_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_clown_orth_net#pick 13 
soft_threshold(grouper_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_grouper_orth_net #pick 13
soft_threshold(goby_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_goby_orth_net #pick 12
soft_threshold(manini_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_manini_orth_net #pick 13
soft_threshold(danio_orth_net_in$wgcna_in)->sft_danio_orth_net #pick 13

rbind(sft_clown_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="clown"),
      sft_grouper_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="grouper"),
      sft_goby_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="goby"),
      sft_manini_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="manini"),
      sft_danio_orth_net$fitIndices %>% mutate(sp="danio")) %>% dplyr::select(sp,Power,SFT.R.sq,mean.k.,median.k.,max.k.,Density) %>% filter(SFT.R.sq>0.8 & median.k.>10) %>% saveRDS("./RDS/softThres_orth_net.rds")
```

```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-001.5}
soft<-readRDS("./RDS/softThres_orth_net.rds") 
soft %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl() %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), 
                            full_width = F, 
                            position = "left") %>%
  kableExtra::scroll_box(width = "500px", height = "400px")

```

### Making the networks
This step constructs the network.
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-002, eval=FALSE}
#Clown
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = clown_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->clown_orth_net

#Grouper
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = grouper_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->grouper_orth_net

#Goby
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = goby_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 12)->goby_orth_net

#Manini
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = manini_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->manini_orth_net

#Danio
wgcna_adjacency(datExpr = danio_orth_net_in$wgcna_in, power = 13)->danio_orth_net

clown_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/clown_orth_net.rds")
grouper_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/grouper_orth_net.rds")
goby_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/goby_orth_net.rds")
manini_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/manini_orth_net.rds")
danio_orth_net %>% saveRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_orth_net.rds")
```

### Network stats
We see that the networks have almost the same number of modules. This is expected since the gene expression matrix has same number of orthogroups and the soft thresholds were similar. There is slight variation in the average module size and mean connectivity with zebrafish having the lowest average module size, while clownfish modules have the lowest average connectivity.
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-004, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/05_ortholog_networks_and_validation/"}
tibble(Species=c("Clonwfish","Grouper","Goby","Manini","Zebrafish"),
       Number_of_modules=c(length(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(grouper_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(goby_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(manini_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module)),
                           length(danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% distinct(module) %>% pull(module))),
       
       Median_module_size=c(clown_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),
                             grouper_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median(),

                             danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% median()),

                             danio_orth_net$connectivity %>% summarise(m=n(),.by = "module") %>% pull(m) %>% mean()) %>% round(),
       
       Mean_connectivity=c(mean(clown_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(grouper_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(goby_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
                           mean(manini_orth_net$connectivity$degree) %>% round(3),
```

### Annotate orth modules
In this step I annotate the modules. I get annotation for the genes using DeepGOplus.  
I then perform GO term enrichment using hypergeometric test in GSEABase.  
The following chunk performs GO term enrichment. 
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-011, eval=FALSE}
library(GOstats)
library(GO.db)
library(GSEABase)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(RSQLite)

#This annot is processed from DeepGOplus
annot<-readRDS("./annot.rds")

get_GOterms_orth_net<-function(mod){
  net$connectivity %>% filter(module == mod) %>% pull(gene)->orth_mod
  genes<-metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% orth_mod) %>% pull(orths)
    
  
    params_up<-GSEAGOHyperGParams(name = "GO enrich", 
                             geneSetCollection = gsc,
                             geneIds = genes,
                             universeGeneIds = universe,
                             ontology = "BP",
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             conditional = F,
                             testDirection = "over")
    
  Over_up<- hyperGTest(params_up)
  Over_up.pv<-pvalues(Over_up)
  pv.fdr<-p.adjust(Over_up.pv,"fdr")
  summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(FDR = pv.fdr[1:nrow(summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble())]) %>%
    dplyr::select(GOBPID,FDR,Term,Count,Size) %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) -> GOenrich_up #Set the cut-off high just to see what possible processes the genes within modules are involved in
  
  return(GOenrich_up)
}

get_GOterms_homomods<-function(cat,module,gene_set){
  universe<-annot %>% filter(genes %in% metamorph_orthlist$orths)
  gene_list<-gene_set %>% filter(mod==module) %>% pull(genes)
  genes<-metamorph_orthlist %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% gene_list) %>% pull(orths)
  
  
  params_up<-GSEAGOHyperGParams(name = "GO enrich", 
                             geneSetCollection = gsc,
                             geneIds = genes,
                             universeGeneIds = universe,
                             ontology = cat,
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                             conditional = F,
                             testDirection = "over")
  
  Over_up<- hyperGTest(params_up)
  Over_up.pv<-pvalues(Over_up)
  pv.fdr<-p.adjust(Over_up.pv,"fdr")
  summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(FDR = pv.fdr[1:nrow(summary(Over_up) %>% as_tibble())]) %>%
    dplyr::select(paste0("GO",cat,"ID"),FDR,Term,Count,Size) %>% filter(FDR<0.05) -> GOenrich_up #Set the cut-off high just to see what possible processes the genes within modules are involved in
  GOenrich_up %>% mutate(mod=module)->GOenrich_up
  
  return(GOenrich_up)
}

```

## Validating the modules
I imagine that this kind of co-expression network analyses might be a bit new to users. Therefore, I perform some validation to show that the networks capture known interactions between genes and proteins that have been both experimentally determined and obtained through data mining. 
Genes with functional links are expected to be co-regulated. Therefore, they should be placed together in the same co-expression module. I compared the results of the co-expression network module assignment with a previously published study that established functional links between thyroid hormone regulation, visual systems development, and lipid metabolism, based on experiments using exogenous thyroid hormone treatment in clownfish *Amphiprion ocellaris*.  While this represents a different physiological state (leading to a different regulatory context) than my dataset, I expect to recapture at least some of the functional links in the network, i.e. find genes co-expressed together in the same module. I compared the co-expression patterns of a list of genes from the study to determine what proportion of those genes were co-expressed together in the same module. The list of genes can be found in table S1. 
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-014, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/05_ortholog_networks_and_validation/"}

th_genes<-read_csv("./07.Systems_genes/T.hormones_genes.csv")
vision_genes<-read_csv("./07.Systems_genes/vision_genes.csv")
lipids_genes<-read_csv("./07.Systems_genes/metabolism.lipids_genes.csv")

#Thyroid

full_orths %>% filter(Orthogroup %in% (orth %>% filter(orths %in% th_signalling_genes$ensembl_gene_id_version) %>% pull(Orthogroup)))->full_thyroid_orths

full_thyroid_orths %>% left_join((orth %>% filter(orths %in% th_signalling_genes$ensembl_gene_id_version)) %>% left_join(th_signalling_genes %>% dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id_version,external_gene_name), by = c("orths"="ensembl_gene_id_version")))->full_thyroid_orths

#Vision
```

```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-015, eval=FALSE}
co_occurence_sig_test<-function(orth_net,sys1,sys2){
  
  #co-occurence dataset for system genes that are expressed in the same module
  co_occur_df<-orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
    mutate(co_mod=case_when(gene %in% sys1$Orthogroup | 
      gene %in% sys2$Orthogroup ~ "co-occur", 
      .default = "co-occur_not"))
  
  #make an additional random gene set for sanity check
  co_occur_df_random<-orth_net$connectivity %>% dplyr::select(gene,module) %>% 
    mutate(co_mod=case_when(
      gene %in% sample(orth_net$connectivity$gene,length(sys1$Orthogroup)) | 
        gene %in% sample(orth_net$connectivity$gene,length(sys2$Orthogroup)) ~ "co-occur", 
      .default = "co-occur_not"))
  
  #test the target gene sets
  tibble(target_set_pval=
           (fisher.test(table(co_occur_df$module, co_occur_df$co_mod), 
                        simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 5000, alternative = "greater"))$p.value,
         random_set_pval= 
           (fisher.test(table(co_occur_df_random$module, co_occur_df_random$co_mod), 
                        simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 5000, alternative = "greater"))$p.value
) %>% return()

}

rbind(
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = clown_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="clownfish", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = manini_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="manini", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = goby_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="goby", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = grouper_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="grouper", sys="thyroid~vision"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_vision_orths,
                      orth_net = danio_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="zebrafish", sys="thyroid~vision")
  ) %>% 
  rbind(
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = clown_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="clownfish", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = manini_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="manini", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = goby_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="goby", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = grouper_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="grouper", sys="thyroid~lipid"),
  co_occurence_sig_test(sys1 = full_thyroid_orths,
                      sys2 = full_lipid_orths,
                      orth_net = danio_orth_net) %>% 
    mutate(sp="zebrafish", sys="thyroid~lipid")
  )->co_occurence_tests

co_occurence_tests %>% saveRDS("./RDS/co_occurence_tests.rds")

```

Genes associated with thyroid hormone regulation were distributed across multiple modules, with roughly one-third (~33%) expressed equally across two modules. Genes related to lipid metabolism and vision also spanned multiple modules, with the majority (~80%) co-expressed in modules containing multiple genes from each system. Comparable patterns were observed in other species as well.

#### STRING comparison
Next, I validated modules by comparing the gene interactions estimated in the zebrafish network, with those reported in the STRING database. The STRING database integrates information on known and predicted protein-protein interactions (PPIs) based on both physical interaction and functional associations. For each gene in the network I identified the interactions that were also reported in the STRING database. I then calculated the number of intra-module interactions per module (when two genes are co-expressed in the same module and also have a reported PPI) and divided it by the total number of reported interactions in the STRING database. This ‘STRING-overlap-score’(range: 0.01-0.127) quantifies the degree of overlap between the number of interactions I observe in the network versus the number of all interactions reported for each gene/protein in the database. 

```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-020, eval=FALSE}
#Load the data
danio_orth_net<-readRDS("./02.Gene_expression_and_network/danio_orth_net.rds")
orth_danio<-orth %>% filter(sp=="Danio_rerio") %>% mutate(orths=str_remove(orths,"\\.[0-9]"))
orth_danio<-orth_danio %>% mutate(Orthogroup=as.character(orth_danio$Orthogroup))
danio_biomart<-read_csv("./Danio_biomart.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(`Gene stable ID`,`Protein stable ID`,`Gene name`, `Gene description`)
#STRING data
string<-read_csv("./7955.protein.links.v12.0.csv")
string<-string %>% mutate(protein1=str_remove(protein1,"7955."), 
                          protein2=str_remove(protein2,"7955."))

# can try using a score threshold
# the outcome is the same with or without a threshold
#string<-string %>% filter(combined_score >= quantile(string$combined_score, 0.5)) 
danio_orth_mods<-left_join(danio_orth_net$connectivity, orth_danio, by=c("gene"="Orthogroup")) %>% 
  left_join(danio_biomart, by=c("orths"="Gene stable ID")) %>% na.omit()

#Make df with STRING data
ppi_mods<-left_join(string,danio_orth_mods, by = c("protein1" = "Protein stable ID"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::rename(module.X = module) %>% left_join(danio_orth_mods, by = c("protein2" = "Protein stable ID"),relationship = "many-to-many") %>% 
  na.omit() %>% dplyr::rename(module.Y = module)

#Identify intra-module interactions
intra_module_ppis <- ppi_mods %>%
  filter(module.X == module.Y) 
#Count the number of instances of genes co-occuring in the same module
intra_module_ppis_counts<-intra_module_ppis %>%
  dplyr::count(module.X, name = "Num_Interactions") 

total_interactions_per_module <- ppi_mods %>%
  dplyr::count(module.X, name = "Total_Interactions") 

intra_module_ppis_counts %>%
  left_join(total_interactions_per_module, by = "module.X") %>%
  mutate(Enrichment_Score = Num_Interactions / Total_Interactions)->intra_module_ppis_summary

danio_orth_net$connectivity  %>% group_by(module) %>% mutate(mean_connectivity=mean(degree)) %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(module, .keep_all = TRUE)->mean_connect

left_join(intra_module_ppis_summary, mean_connect, by=c("module.X"="module"))->ppi_summ_connectivity
ppi_summ_connectivity %>% saveRDS("./RDS/ppi_summ_connectivity")
```

Correlation test between enrichment score ~ connectivity
 I observe a significant correlation between mean module connectivity, and enrichment score (Spearman correlation test P = 4.4e-0.5, rho=0.66), suggesting that interactions between genes with a large number of connections in our network were more frequently reported in the STRING database (Fig S3C).
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-021, cache=TRUE, cache.path="cache/05_ortholog_networks_and_validation/"}
ppi_summ_connectivity<-readRDS("./RDS/ppi_summ_connectivity")
cor.test(ppi_summ_connectivity$Enrichment_Score,ppi_summ_connectivity$mean_connectivity, method = "spearman")

```

A permutation test with 1000 random gene-module reassignments confirmed that a number of observed intra-module interactions in our network were significantly higher than expected by chance. Specifically,  42% (14 of the 33 modules) of the modules capture known interactions between genes. It is important to note that despite the STRING database comprising multiple data modalities (e.g. interaction experiments, computation interaction prediction from co-expression, annotation of complexes/pathways etc.) and different experimental designs, almost half the modules in our network comprise known PPIs. These results demonstrate the power of co-expression modules to not only capture transcriptional similarity but reproduce known PPIs.  
```{r 05_ortholog_networks_and_validation-chunk-022, eval=FALSE}
#permuted_counts <- replicate(n_permu, {
#make random module assignments  
  permute_string_module_counts <- function(danio_orth_mods,
                                           string,
                                           intra_module_ppis_counts,
                                           n_perm = 1000,
                                           seed = seed) {

    # Keep only the columns that I  need
    module_df <- danio_orth_mods %>%transmute(Protein_ID = `Protein stable ID`,
        module = module)
    
    # Observed modules and counts
    observed_counts <- intra_module_ppis_counts %>%
      dplyr::select(module.X, Num_Interactions) %>% distinct() %>%
      dplyr::rename(observed_interactions = Num_Interactions)
    
    all_modules <- module_df %>% distinct(module) %>% dplyr::rename(module.X = module) %>%
      left_join(observed_counts, by = "module.X") %>%
      mutate(observed_interactions = replace_na(observed_interactions, 0))
    
    # single permutation
    one_permutation <- function() {
      #make a dataset with genes and random module assignments; random version of danio orth mods
      shuffled_df <- module_df %>% mutate(shuffled_module = sample(module))
      #make the ppi_mods df using the random module assignments
      ppi_shuffled <- string %>% left_join(
        shuffled_df %>% dplyr::select(Protein_ID, shuffled_module),
        by = c("protein1" = "Protein_ID"),  relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        dplyr::rename(module.X = shuffled_module) %>%
        left_join(shuffled_df %>% dplyr::select(Protein_ID, shuffled_module),
          by = c("protein2" = "Protein_ID"),relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        dplyr::rename(module.Y = shuffled_module) %>%
        drop_na(module.X, module.Y)
      
      shuffled_counts <- ppi_shuffled %>% filter(module.X == module.Y) %>%
        dplyr::count(module.X, name = "shuffled_interactions")
      
      #Calculate the perm_ge_obs per module and them summarise them after running the function. 
      all_modules %>% left_join(shuffled_counts, by = "module.X") %>% mutate(
          shuffled_interactions = replace_na(shuffled_interactions, 0),
          perm_ge_obs = as.integer(shuffled_interactions >= observed_interactions)) %>%
        dplyr::select(module.X, perm_ge_obs)
    }
    
    # Run permutations and compute empirical P per module
    map_dfr(seq_len(n_perm), ~ one_permutation(), .id = "perm_id") %>%
      group_by(module.X) %>%
      summarise(
        empirical_P = mean(perm_ge_obs),
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(empirical_P_BH = p.adjust(empirical_P, method = "BH")) %>%
      arrange(empirical_P)
    }
  
STRING_perm_test_res <- permute_string_module_counts(
    danio_orth_mods = danio_orth_mods,
    string = string,
    intra_module_ppis_counts = intra_module_ppis_counts,
    n_perm = 1000,
    seed = 123)

STRING_perm_test_res %>% dplyr::count(empirical_P_BH < 0.05)

STRING_perm_test_res %>% saveRDS("./RDS/STRING_perm_test_res.rds")
```
